name: Caltech Winter 2016

venue.name: [California Institute of Technology](http://www.caltech.edu/)
venue.details: Winnett Lounge; See website for more details.

information: The cost of registration is $4 + 2n, where n is the number of events you sign up for. You must register online - there is no on-site registration. If you are a Caltech student, just show your student ID and the registration fee will be waived. There is a 100-person competitor limit. $1 per competitor goes to the WCA. The fee will be waived for those who are willing to help staff.
